name: Nepal Earthquake 2015
summary: 7.8 magnitude earthquake struck central Nepal, devastating Kathmandu Valley and surrounding districts, triggering avalanches on Everest and landslides across the Himalayas.

name: Kerala Floods 2018
summary: Heaviest monsoon rainfall in nearly a century caused severe flooding across Kerala, affecting all 14 districts and triggering major landslides.

name: Odisha Cyclone Fani 2019
summary: Extremely severe cyclonic storm made landfall near Puri with wind speeds up to 200 km/h, one of the strongest storms to hit Odisha in 20 years.

name: Uttarakhand Flash Flood 2021
summary: Glacial burst triggered a flash flood in the Rishiganga and Dhauliganga rivers, destroying hydropower projects and villages.

name: Sikkim Glacial Lake Outburst 2023
summary: South Lyonak glacial lake outburst caused flash floods along the Teesta river, damaging the Chungthang dam and downstream settlements.

name: Gujarat Earthquake 2001
summary: 7.7 magnitude earthquake centered near Bhuj, one of the deadliest earthquakes in Indian history.

name: Maharashtra Heatwave 2024
summary: Prolonged extreme heat conditions across central India with temperatures exceeding 45C for multiple days.

name: Assam Flood 2024
summary: Annual monsoon flooding of the Brahmaputra river system inundated large parts of Assam, displacing lakhs of residents.

name: Turkey-Syria Earthquake 2023
summary: 7.8 magnitude earthquake followed by a 7.5 aftershock devastated southern Turkey and northern Syria.

name: Himachal Pradesh Landslides 2023
summary: Torrential monsoon rains triggered widespread landslides across Himachal Pradesh, damaging roads and residential areas.
